title: An adoption PR push names the missing workflows permission and its remedy
body:
Why: Python pilot t-811vn27 adoption: `krn pr ship --repo krn-works/krn-pilot-py` push was rejected "refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow `.github/workflows/ci.yml` without `workflows` permission"; the lead pushed the branch with the operator keyring login, then shipped. Every adoption PR writes .github/workflows/ci.yml, so an unattended adoption cannot push.
Outcome: either the KRN App (krn-works-delivery) holds Workflows: write (App settings, operator-owned; then installations accept it) and `krn pr ship` pushes adoption PRs, or `krn pr ship` on exit 70 with this rejection prints the exact remedy (keyring push command or the App permission to grant) instead of "after a rebase rerun with --force".
Proof: a test feeding the verbatim rejection text asserts the remedy message; the next adoption pushes without the keyring.
